evidence_items.locator: section 'AI-Driven Legal Research Tools Still Hallucinate', paragraph 1

receipt.public_excerpt: But even these bespoke legal AI tools still hallucinate an alarming amount of the time: the Lexis+ AI and Ask Practical Law AI systems produced incorrect information more than 17% of the time, while Westlaw’s AI-Assisted Research hallucinated more than 34% of the time.

evidence_items.explanation: In mid-2024, LLM products whose providers claimed they 'avoid' hallucinations still hallucinated on 17% to 34% or more of test queries.

receipt.public_excerpt: In a prerecorded video showcasing SearchGPT, the tool provided incorrect information about the dates of the Appalachian Summer Festival in Boone, North Carolina.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's newest system made a factual error in its launch demo days before the post.

unresolved_gaps: Whether hallucinations are truly 'inevitable' is not settled by this evidence and is not scored.
